source_message: User asked to complete the persistent memory mechanism so network interruptions do not force repeated work.
goal: Make work recoverable after connection/session interruption without repeating already verified steps; connect source ingestion, approved semantic-memory processing, index refresh, and next-session restore, while preserving provenance and project boundaries.
confirmed_completed: Resumable source-ingestion runner exists and has CI tests for dry-run, apply/replay, uncertain registry acknowledgement after crash, tampered ledger, and missing state projection reconstruction.
Archive staging to sanitized intake to metadata-only source registry is implemented.
Concurrent intake publication race was reproduced, fixed, and covered by a two-process regression test.
Strict write-contract audit is enabled in CI.
The runner explicitly stops at SOURCE_REGISTERED_DOWNSTREAM_PENDING and does not claim semantic promotion, canonical index refresh, or automatic next-session restore.

Added tools/continuity_checkpoint_bundle.py: immutable paired TASK_STATE/HANDOFF generation, hash-linked parent generations, atomic CURRENT_CHECKPOINT pointer as the commit point, OS-managed lock, drift verification, and replay recovery after interruption.

Added six behavioral tests covering capture/verify, interruption after pointer publication, paired projection recovery, idempotent replay, parent-chain preservation, tamper rejection, and missing-pointer fail-closed behavior (five named test methods plus idempotent replay; total six tests).
Added strict write-contract classification for the checkpoint bundle and documented capture/verify/recover usage in core/agent_runtime_protocol.md.
Exact-head CI for 30be5e944d6dd2d8a60395626b52ef07ff898640 passed: 201 tests, one skipped; 85 mutation sites, zero unclassified.
Updated TASK_STATE.md and HANDOFF.md with a current continuation checkpoint and the next single action; preserved prior checkpoint history rather than replacing it.
Appended implementation event EVT-AGMS-20261015-001 to the AGENT_MEMORY_SYSTEM event journal.

Added tools/turn_lifecycle_ledger.py and tests/test_turn_lifecycle_ledger.py: exact user instruction/checkpoint capture when invoked by a client, append-only turn lifecycle, progress/artifact/report/submission/delivery states, idempotent replay, corrupt-journal fail-closed behavior, and empty/partial artifact scan.

Added core/turn_lifecycle_and_interruption_recovery.md and linked it from core/agent_runtime_protocol.md; documented 10–12 minute work slices, uncertainty semantics, artifact correlation, and the hard boundary that automatic ChatGPT capture requires a client integration.
Exact code HEAD 49b11d8ba6cb52fa9cef1159dd3e0d4132cae529 passed GitHub Actions run 38753181276: 212 tests, 1 skipped; write audit 90 mutation sites / 0 unclassified.
Preserved append-only chronology correction EVT-AGMS-20261015-003 for the temporal edge in EVT-AGMS-20261015-002.

Added authenticated loopback HTTP adapter tools/turn_lifecycle_adapter.py with exact-origin CORS allowlist, bearer-token auth, body/field validation, inspection endpoints, and fail-closed handling for corrupt ledger reads.

Added clients/turn_lifecycle_client.js. runTrackedTurn blocks the work callback until the durable incoming-message receipt and WORK_STARTED event are acknowledged; SDK distinguishes prepared report, submitted response and explicit delivery acknowledgement.

Added Python HTTP integration tests and Node SDK tests; CI now runs both test suites. Exact code HEAD cf78d65d1ffa2421ce6e8a24d262812550ab30c9 passed GitHub Actions run 38761636991: 223 Python tests (1 skipped), 4 Node tests; strict write audit passed with no unclassified mutation sites.
Added core/turn_lifecycle_client_adapter.md and linked the adapter contract from core/agent_runtime_protocol.md.

Added clients/chatgpt-web-extension/ as a local-only MV3 prototype for the ChatGPT web interface: send interception, durable IndexedDB registration before dispatch, exact user text plus previous assistant message capture, lifecycle events, DOM-based final-answer observation, incomplete-turn popup, recovery prompt copy, and explicit JSONL export.

Added static extension contract tests and CI JavaScript syntax checks. Exact branch HEAD d707a91f9662cb1aa451db4fba1596baef8511a9 passed GitHub Actions run 38762303927: 227 Python tests, 1 skipped, 4 Node SDK tests, strict write audit 92 mutation sites / 0 unclassified, extension JS syntax checks passed.

Yandex Browser's official Android documentation confirms third-party extension installation and developer-mode testing are supported in principle; actual behavior on the user's installed version remains unverified.

At code HEAD e30450a5ed516ab1f76f65c3c7874cdd2b951c40, exact-head CI run 38772804206 passed: 230 Python tests (1 skipped), 4 Node tests, strict write audit 92 mutation sites / 0 unclassified, extension JavaScript syntax checks passed.

Closed the causal restoration gap: restore_session_packet follows explicit event links transitively, keeps journal order, and reports PARTIAL for missing transitive event references; unit tests cover complete and incomplete ancestry.

Extended the end-to-end regression scenario across branch result publication, owner acknowledgement, guarded task update, paired checkpoint capture/recovery after simulated projection interruption, and fresh-process restore.

Audited the source-ingestion route: source_ingestion_runner connects staging → intake adapter → route validation → metadata-only source registration; existing tests cover replay, crash after registry commit, projection rebuild, and tamper rejection. Semantic promotion and canonical index refresh remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED; next-session restore remains NOT_VERIFIED.

confirmed_open.description: Inspect existing lifecycle/approval contracts. No canonical semantic-promotion executor was found in inspected tools. Specify and test an executor before implementing; never treat metadata-only source registration as accepted memory.
No verified canonical memory-index refresh executor is connected to the ingestion runner. archive_temporal_index.py is a read-only archive search/index, not a canonical memory index rebuild.
Restore reads project TASK_STATE.md, HANDOFF.md and events.jsonl; source registration does not automatically update or restore these records.

TASK_STATE.md and HANDOFF.md are not protected by a single paired-write protocol. Their history contains stale checkpoints; the latest verified repository state must be compared with checkpoint metadata before resuming.

A report that was never durably written to the repository cannot be reconstructed verbatim after a network interruption. Future work must persist concise checkpoints after each material verified milestone and distinguish persisted records from undelivered response text.

The ChatGPT web extension is a prototype verified by static CI only. Must be installed and tested in the user's actual Yandex Browser Android version. Verify send gate (no send before durable receipt), exact text and prior assistant message capture, interrupted connection recovery, response DOM detection, multiple incomplete turns, extension restart, and UI-selector drift. Until these pass, do not claim end-to-end capture is operational.

next_action: P1: make the historical source checkpoint, latest verified code HEAD/CI, and metadata revision unambiguous in task state, handoff, checkpoint JSON, and PR description; then read back the resulting revision and report exact evidence.
constraints: Do not merge PR #27 or modify main without explicit user approval.
Do not delete or rewrite source-history exports without a separate explicit decision.
Keep project histories isolated; unknown project applicability remains unknown.
Preserve chronology, failed attempts, uncertainty, and source provenance.
No semantic record is accepted merely because source metadata was registered.
Never report CI success for a SHA other than the exact checked SHA.
checkpoint_semantics: This is a durable task checkpoint committed to the integration branch. It is not an automatic ChatGPT autosave or proof that an undelivered response was saved.

repository_state.note: This is the latest verified code HEAD as of 2026-10-15, before the P1 metadata-only update. CI evidence applies only to this exact code SHA; subsequent metadata commits do not imply code changed or that CI ran on those metadata-only commits.

historical_repository_state.note: Exact-head CI verifies code HEAD e30450a5ed516ab1f76f65c3c7874cdd2b951c40. Following commits update checkpoint/task/handoff metadata only; application code remains unchanged.

revision_semantics.source_code_checkpoint: Historical milestone retained in the original source_code_checkpoint object; it is not the current code HEAD.
revision_semantics.latest_verified_code_head: repository_state.last_verified_code_head; paired only with repository_state.exact_head_ci_run_id and its exact-head result.
revision_semantics.metadata_revision: The Git commit containing this metadata is the authoritative metadata revision. It is intentionally not embedded as a self-referential SHA in this file; record the resulting commit SHA in the handoff and PR description after write/read-back.
revision_semantics.chronology_rule: Do not overwrite earlier checkpoint evidence when a newer code or metadata revision appears. Append a new verification record or preserve the earlier state under historical_repository_state.
